title: Nocera Advances AI Infrastructure Strategy with QMAX Technology Acquisition
excerpt: The deal gives Nocera access to authorized Micron/Crucial memory distribution channels, supporting its planned expansion into AI infrastructure and data cent...
content_html:
Fiona Craig

Wed, July 29, 2026 at 7:29 AM PDT 3 min read

The deal gives Nocera access to authorized Micron/Crucial memory distribution channels, supporting its planned expansion into AI infrastructure and data centers.

Key Investor Takeaways

  • Nocera (NASDAQ:NCRA) acquired a controlling 30% interest in QMAX through a VIE structure for approximately $408,000 in restricted stock, with no cash consideration.

  • The acquisition adds authorized Micron/Crucial memory and storage distribution qualifications, strengthening Nocera's AI infrastructure strategy.

  • QMAX generated approximately $1.36 million in fiscal 2025 revenue after nearly ten-fold growth since fiscal 2023, according to the company.

  • The transaction expands Nocera's position within the AI infrastructure supply chain by securing access to critical memory and storage components.

  • Management said the acquisition supports both the company's planned AI data center projects and potential third-party infrastructure opportunities.

Why NCRA Stock Is in Focus

Nocera (NASDAQ:NCRA) announced it has acquired a controlling 30% interest in Taiwan-based QMAX Technology through a variable interest entity (VIE) structure, issuing 300,000 restricted common shares valued at approximately $408,000. No cash was used in the transaction.

QMAX is an authorized distributor of Micron/Crucial memory products, providing Nocera with established sales qualifications, vendor authorizations, and distribution relationships covering DRAM modules, ECC server memory, and solid-state storage products.

According to the company, QMAX's business generated approximately $1.36 million in fiscal 2025 revenue following nearly ten-fold growth from fiscal 2023, while also expanding its export sales.

Nocera said the acquisition is intended to support its broader transformation into a technology-focused holding company with operations spanning artificial intelligence, AI infrastructure, data centers, robotics, biotech, blockchain, and digital assets. Management stated that QMAX's supply chain capabilities will support both the company's planned AI data center developments and future sales to third-party data center operators.

Why This Matters for Investors

The acquisition moves Nocera further along its strategy of building exposure to AI infrastructure rather than remaining focused solely on individual technology investments. By adding an operating distribution platform with established supplier relationships, the company gains capabilities that may complement its planned AI data center initiatives.

Management argues that memory and storage have become increasingly important components of AI infrastructure as demand for AI servers continues to grow. Access to authorized procurement channels could reduce supply-chain challenges as the company pursues additional AI-related projects.

该交易使 Nocera 能够获得授权的美光/英睿达内存分销渠道，支持其向人工智能基础设施和数据中心的扩张计划。

主要投资者要点

  • Nocera（纳斯达克股票代码：NCRA）通过 VIE 结构以约 408,000 美元的限制性股票收购了 QMAX 30% 的控股权，无现金对价。
  • 此次收购增加了 Micron/Crucial 内存和存储授权分销资质，强化了 Nocera 的人工智能基础设施战略。
  • 该公司表示，QMAX 自 2023 财年以来增长了近十倍，2025 财年的收入约为 136 万美元。
  • 该交易通过确保对关键内存和存储组件的访问，扩大了 Nocera 在人工智能基础设施供应链中的地位。
  • 管理层表示，此次收购既支持了公司计划中的人工智能数据中心项目，也支持了潜在的第三方基础设施机会。

为什么 NCRA 股票成为焦点

Nocera（纳斯达克股票代码：NCRA）宣布通过可变利益实体（VIE）结构收购台湾 QMAX Technology 30% 的控股权，发行 300,000 股限制性普通股，价值约 408,000 美元。 交易中没有使用现金。

QMAX 是 Micron/Crucial 内存产品的授权经销商，为 Nocera 提供涵盖 DRAM 模块、ECC 服务器内存和固态存储产品的既定销售资格、供应商授权和分销关系。

该公司表示，QMAX 的业务在 2025 财年收入约为 136 万美元，较 2023 财年增长近十倍，同时还扩大了出口销售。

诺塞拉表示，此次收购旨在支持其更广泛地转型为一家以技术为中心的控股公司，业务涵盖人工智能、人工智能基础设施、数据中心、机器人、生物技术、区块链和数字资产。 管理层表示，QMAX的供应链能力将支持该公司计划的人工智能数据中心开发以及未来向第三方数据中心运营商的销售。

为什么这对投资者很重要

此次收购使 Nocera 进一步推进其建立人工智能基础设施的战略，而不是仅仅专注于个别技术投资。 通过添加一个已建立供应商关系的运营分销平台，该公司获得了可以补充其计划的人工智能数据中心计划的能力。

管理层认为，随着对人工智能服务器的需求不断增长，内存和存储已成为人工智能基础设施中越来越重要的组成部分。 随着公司寻求更多与人工智能相关的项目，获得授权采购渠道可以减少供应链挑战。
